summary: E-mail about MV IVELLE STAR arrives in the operations inbox: URGENT: overdue invoice SBT-25-0187

email.subject: URGENT: overdue invoice SBT-25-0187
email.body:
Dear Operations team,

Please find below our invoice for the bunkers delivered to MV IVELLE STAR at Bilbao on 18 January 2025.

Invoice: SBT-25-0187
Delivered: 380.0 t VLSFO, 45.0 t MGO
Amount due: USD 239,960.00
Payment terms: 30 days from delivery

Kindly use the remittance details below from today and update your records before payment:

Solent Bunker Trading Ltd
Harbour Mercantile Bank, Valletta
Account no. 0000 4471 2290, SWIFT HMBKMTMT

This payment is now overdue. Please remit today to avoid suspension of supplies to your fleet.

For any questions please call our accounts desk on +44 20 7946 0884.

Kind regards,
Claire Ashdown
Accounts Receivable
Solent Bunker Trading Ltd

Dear Solent Bunker Trading Accounts,

We confirm that we have updated our remittance details to the new bank account you provided: Solent Bunker Trading Ltd, Harbour Mercantile Bank, Valletta, Account no. 0000 4471 2290, SWIFT HMBKMTMT.

We will arrange payment today of the overdue invoice SBT-25-0187 for USD 239,960.00 for 380.0 t VLSFO and 45.0 t MGO delivered on 18 January 2025.

Kindly confirm receipt and advise if any further action is required.

Best regards,
MV IVELLE STAR
